The '''''Dragon Queen II''''' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] in [[44 ABY]] under command of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]. It assisted in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]. Later, it served as the location for the [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo|wedding]] of [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]].
